title: Geometric top homology of affine space is fixed by automorphisms
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, N a positive integer, A a finite commutative ring with NA=0, and suppose N is invertible on Spec(k). Fix ordinary finite Tate transport t and d >= 0. For any automorphism e of the affine coordinate tower of relative dimension d over Spec(k), with its Cartesian square over the identity, the endomorphism affineLinearTraceAction of [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action] induces the identity on degree-zero homology. This is the top compact-support cohomology after the ordered Tate twist and shift, in the categories of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. No assertion over a general base or about derived faithfulness is included.

source.place: paragraph 2, geometric fibre degree-one calculation before applying the affine counit

proof.text: Take the polynomial deformation of e over the affine line from the new geometric lemma: its zero fibre is an invertible linear map g and its one fibre is e. Form the actual affineLinearTraceAction of this family. The construction contains no coefficient or trace data.

Prove base-change equivariance of the action in the private action_baseChange lemma. First express both coefficient comparisons by descent from the base coefficient. Associativity of leftDerivedUpperStarComp identifies the two inverse-image composites, including naturality of coefficient descent. Apply affineLinearExchange_action_naturality to their equivariance equation and conjugate through affineLinearCompactComparison. The endpoint actions are therefore conjugate to the endpoint restrictions of the family action.

The private linear_action_id lemma specializes the universal matrix action at the identity section, using affineLinearAction_one and affineLinearAction_family. Apply linearAction_eq_id_of_identitySection, and then specialize at g and cancel the specialization isomorphism. Thus the zero endpoint action is identity.

Prove line_zero_detects. A normalized trace from exists_affineSpaceTopTrace makes the affine trace source over the parameter line isomorphic to the constant unit complex, hence tensor-invertible. Every point belongs to the inverse image of its base point; that fibre is irreducible by the open geometrically irreducible affine-space projection and meets the closed zero section. Apply the proved source theorem eq_id_of_leftDerivedUpperStar_map_eq_id_of_isInvertible to this section and these preconnected sets. This is identity detection for an invertible object, not faithfulness of general derived pullback.

Cancel the zero-endpoint comparison to obtain identity of the restricted family action; line_zero_detects then makes the family action identity. Restrict at one and cancel its comparison to obtain identity of the actual action of e. Apply the degree-zero homology functor and its identity law. The same argument covers d=0 and the zero coefficient ring.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2, presentation invariance below the unit level; polynomial deformation replaces rational-point generators, while retaining the ordered trace and linear invariance

theorem affineSpaceIsoTraceAction_homology_zero
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hk : IsUnit (N : Γ(Spec (.of k), ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (e : affineTraceTower (Spec (.of k)) d ≅ affineTraceTower (Spec (.of k)) d)
    (sq : IsPullback e.hom (affineTraceProjection (Spec (.of k)) d)
      (affineTraceProjection (Spec (.of k)) d) (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))) :
    (_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf (Spec (.of k)).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) 0).map
        (affineLinearTraceAction N hN A hA t (Spec (.of k)) hk d e.hom sq) = 𝟙 _
